description.susinstantswap: Hold the inventory key and release to swap with the selected hotbar slot. A short press opens the inventory normally.
config.susinstantswap.title: Su's Instant Swap Config
config.susinstantswap.modEnabled.tooltip: Master switch. When off, the inventory key behaves normally.
config.susinstantswap.soundEnabled.toolt: Play a sound when swapping items.
config.susinstantswap.mouseReposition.to: Move the cursor to the bottom-right when opening a vanilla container or inventory.
config.susinstantswap.guiSwapEnabled.too: Swap and close using the GUI swap key. Uses the inventory key if unbound. Disabled by default.
config.susinstantswap.emptySlotSwapEnabl: Allow swapping with an empty slot.
config.susinstantswap.debug.tooltip: Log the menu, slot and hotbar indices when swapping.
